reviewedPreparation.bindingPolicy: Use these existing T006/T014 prepared-case facts for the authored opening. known-A/known-B and declared-path are fixture roles, not new production IDs or invented story names. UI presents their actual authored names; source correspondence is reviewed at T023/T030.

objectives.name: Read the silent link in R01

ui.policy: Proposed functional accessible labels for T023–T029 integration, not existing UI or new story facts. Object-specific names may be mapped here after content review; required behavior stays fixed. Notebook and Inventory are named dialogs; their sections/lists are named semantic regions/lists. Evidence entries have heading, source, condition and freshness text.

text.powerCaveat: Power indication does not prove a data link.
text.scopeClue: Inspect the physical path between known-good endpoints.
text.guestStatus: Guest — progress is only in this session.
text.signInExplanation: Sign in to save your adventure.

ui.endpointPolicy: The displayed Known-good endpoints list has two distinct named entries ending in ' — known good'. The displayed Physical path under test list orders the same endpoint names first and last, with any authored intermediate components between. No endpoint or component name is guessed here.
ui.introductoryInventoryPolicy: T023 must bind a real introductory inventory item/effect for the replay case. Its name and award are authored content decisions; the tested baseline must be nonempty. Inventory rows expose Quantity: followed by a positive integer, so replay compares quantities as well as names. This does not prescribe an extra fictional item or count an asset as finished.
ui.dialogueEvidencePolicy: Power and communication / Investigation scope are functional clue labels to bind to the actual Photon/Titan clue-bearing topics. Their required meanings come from O01/O02, not newly invented dialogue. Skipping either topic retains its evidence; replay cannot duplicate it.
ui.measurementPolicy: A physical inspection entry exposes the observed result and source. After a real supported path change, the old entry remains stale and a new inspection adds a current entry; an old result is not silently relabeled current. Exact numeric grading remains in the separately reviewed physical cases.
